title: Singing with megaphones and her powerful voice
summary: Without microphones, bands used megaphones, which Humes thinks explains why she sings so loud. She credits God for her voice and has no explanation for her breath control.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: Oh. They didn't have microphones and so on at that time, or did they?
And then later on - oh, but that was way late in years. Then they just had the megaphones.
And I guess that's how I started singing so loud. You know, sometimes people would say, you don't need no mike. And I had been places where they'd say, let me hear you sing without the mike.
It's amazing. Nobody in these days
